voice.sentenceGuideline: Lead with the verified present state, use concrete nouns and active verbs, and add technical depth only when it improves understanding.

rules: First-person identity, focus, contact, and reflection copy requires Carlos's approval.
Project summaries, contribution boundaries, source-derived outcomes, and biography facts use third person.
Editorial learnings are never written as Carlos's first-person reflection without approval.
The interface addresses the visitor as you only when it helps them understand or complete an action.
We is used only for a named and verified collaboration.
Preserve the approved Enter the Observatory and Explore Selected Work labels until a deliberate revision is approved.
All caps are limited to official all-cap names, technical abbreviations, and accessible compact metadata.
Generic project categories and status words remain lowercase inside sentences.
Use terminal punctuation for prose, captions, errors, privacy notes, and explanations.
Omit terminal punctuation from short navigation labels, buttons, filters, and compact status tags.
Use numerals for versions, counts, dimensions, durations, and technical limits.
Use ISO dates in internal ledgers and readable dates in public prose.
Hyphenate compound modifiers when doing so improves clarity.

statusLabels.useWhen: The intended public experience or product is available and the shipped scope is evidenced.
A usable artifact exists and current maintenance evidence has been checked.
A working implementation exists, but completeness, reliability, release, or adoption is not established.
The work primarily tests an idea, architecture, interaction, or technical path.
The item is an approved idea, visual, or navigational object without project evidence.
Content or implementation is being prepared and is not yet available as a case study.
The artifact remains part of the record but is not actively maintained.
Verification, contribution, privacy, rights, or release gates prevent publication.
The source or asset is intentionally not public and has no public action.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not claim sole creation, implementation, design, or ownership from account or repository ownership.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: An approved contribution record naming Carlos's work and relevant collaborators.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not call a prototype production-ready, enterprise-ready, professional-grade, battle-tested, or proven at scale.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: Verified release scope, real use, reliability, and current operational evidence.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not claim secure, hardened, completely isolated, privacy-first, anonymous, or safe by default.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: A defined threat model, tested controls, privacy behavior, and completed review.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not claim guaranteed offline delivery, catastrophe readiness, emergency readiness, or life-critical suitability.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: Field tests, safety constraints, delivery evidence, and approved operational scope.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not call a repository open source or MIT-licensed when the distributed repository lacks its license file.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: The applicable license file and any required attribution record.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not claim a working installer, marketplace listing, passing CI, release, demo, or live service without a dated check.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: Current primary-source metadata and a successful relevant availability check.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not promise automatic accessibility, security, deployment, design quality, productivity, or provider stability from AI-assisted workflows.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: A scoped evaluation or audit for the specific output and environment.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not invent or infer users, revenue, conversion, performance gains, uptime, awards, clients, testimonials, or adoption.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: A primary source, date, scope, and publication approval.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not publish employers, credentials, dates, locations, contact details, collaborators, or roles beyond the approved source boundary.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: User approval and the relevant primary source with privacy review.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not present astrology or numerology as scientific, medical, financial, diagnostic, or predictive authority.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: Not applicable; frame the material as creative or personal practice.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not present generated imagery as a real screenshot, shipped asset, human-authored illustration, or documented outcome.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: A provenance record plus a truthful generated-media label and approved use.

prohibitedClaims.rule: Do not infer public reuse rights from repository visibility, a generated filename, account ownership, or possession of a local file.
prohibitedClaims.evidenceNeeded: File-level ownership, permission or license, attribution, and privacy review.

requiredReviewChecks: Source supports the nouns, verbs, status, contribution, and outcome.
First-person language is approved and editorial inference is not presented as a user quote.
Official product and technology names use canonical casing.
Status is the least ambitious accurate label across every surface.
Links have current verification and unavailable actions are removed or explained.
Selected assets have rights, privacy, caption, alt-text, credit, and accessibility evidence.
Unsupported metrics, collaborators, dates, employers, clients, testimonials, locations, and security claims are absent.
The same meaning remains available without animation, WebGL, audio, video, or chat.
